measurements.after_structural_footprint: Perimeter wall base follows official FID 862 ring at Z=0; roof overhang and entry steps are excluded from the footprint comparison.
measurements.vertical_status: Estimated from the four-level GIS record and facade/roof proportions in exterior photographs. These heights are not surveyed or measured.
measurements.roof_and_orientation: Source footprint is geospatially oriented through the documented transform; main gable ridge runs north/south along the long building axis. Roof form follows the architect's exterior reference, not a measured roof plan.
measurements.source_Shape__Area_units: Not documented; do not treat as local campus-plan area. The raw value exceeds the local-transform ring bbox area; evaluator recomputed ring area independently.

geometry_edits: Replaced the original single-box massing mesh with the 33-vertex official Purdue GIS footprint at grade.
Built a red-brick perimeter shell with limestone base and horizontal belt bands.
Added three above-grade facade bands, with a two-level glazed bay treatment on longer facade segments and punched lower-story windows with aluminum mullions.
Added a gabled roof silhouette with deep eaves, an approximate paired-entry door, a light metal canopy, and shallow steps.
Kept the existing asset ID, blend path, object name, collection name, identity world transform, and one-object export collection.
uncertainties: Purdue GIS provides a source footprint but not certified survey accuracy; the source polygon appears to match the Marriott Hall identity and placement, but exact wall-to-GIS registration remains dependent on the source mapping.
No measured building height or roof elevations were found. GIS Extrution=39 has no documented units; modeled heights remain estimates.
The GIS level count is 4, while the exterior model depicts three above-grade facade bands; interpretation of the fourth level is unverified.
Two institutional/project sources give different building-area figures (42,500 GSF in the 2009 approval and 35,000 sf on the architect page); neither is used as footprint area.
Window bay spacing, facade material color, canopy proportions, and roof overhang are visual estimates.
This asset remains a campus-coordinate massing library; Tobin owns master integration.

The GIS Shape__Area raw value (3423.2) is not consistent with the campus-transform polygon bounds when read as local square meters; field units/meaning are unclear, so the grader recomputed polygon area from the ring (about 1,980.4 m²) and did not use the field for scale.
